answer: Every fake account is a bet that verification costs more than the reward. Affiliated school inspector warrant with education inspectorate attestation flips the bet — a warrant the inspectorate renews after inspection audits — and the horizon lands on the attacker instead. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the island of those crossings is a bill no payout covers. The canyon is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
